note: Hand-authored. Subject takes four to nine hours to reply to every message; observer replies within a couple of minutes. Ground truth: slow replier.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: are you around to talk about the summer plans?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I am, sorry for the slow reply, the day got away from me. The short version is that I would rather not commit to the dates until I know which week the shed is free.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: no worries at all, whenever suits you

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I will confirm by the end of the week, and I will also find out whether the boat is available as a backup, because last year we turned up and it was not.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: sensible, let me know either way

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Will do. I am going to bed now, it is nearly midnight and I still have the roof to look at.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: did you ever get the spare key for the van?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I did, sorry, that took a while. It was at the depot in the end, they had moved it to a different drawer and nobody had updated the system.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: no problem, we can sort it on saturday

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Saturday works, I will bring it with me. I am also going to look at the tyres while I am there, the ones on the near side looked very worn when I drove it last month.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: good plan, I will order a set in the meantime

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Do not spend anything on them, I will get them fitted and pay you back. I am sorry for the slow turn around on this, the last few weeks have been chaos.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: quick one — what did the letting agent say about the deposit?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: They want five weeks, which I think is too much, and they want it before they will even show anyone around. I was going to email you about it but then the evening got busy and I forgot.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: that is steep, do you want me to look up what other places are asking?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: If you have a moment that would help. I have been trying to work out whether to just pay it and move, or start again with a different place in January and risk losing a month of rent.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I will look tonight and send you what I find

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Thank you, that is very helpful. Sorry again for the delay in replying, I know this is the second time this week you have had to chase me.
